sourceChecks.text: and Ishbibenob, who was of the sons of the giant, the weight of whose spear was three hundred shekels of bronze in weight, he being armed with a new sword, thought he would kill David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA21:16はイシュビ・ベノブを「巨人の子ら」の一人とする。巨人の実名・出身地はこの節では示されない。

sourceChecks.text: After this, there was again war with the Philistines at Gob. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Saph, who was of the sons of the giant.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA21:18はサフを「巨人の子ら」の一人とする。巨人の実名・出身地はこの節では示されない。

sourceChecks.text: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had six fingers on every hand and six toes on every foot, twenty-four in number, and he also was born to the giant.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA21:20はガトで戦った背の高い男について「巨人から生まれた」と述べる。

sourceChecks.text: These four were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 2SA21:22は四人をガトの巨人から生まれた者としてまとめる。
